rationale: Read every test, authority/client fixture and table input against actual CLI resolution and production owner/destination assertions. Preserve independent request payload oracles and mixed-version behaviors. A targeted skipped-write mutation already fails original assertions, so no redundant assertion repair is retained.

cases.title: refuses a selector-moving edit onto an SSH host the authority no longer registers
cases.reason: Unregistered destination rejects selector-moving edit before a write RPC.

cases.title: refuses a create onto an SSH host the authority no longer registers
cases.reason: Unregistered destination rejects create before a write RPC.

cases.title: does not drop the fence when reading SSH registrations fails
cases.reason: Registration read timeout is propagated instead of silently omitting the destination fence; zero writes occur.

cases.title: refuses a selector-moving edit when the host is re-registered between capture and write
cases.reason: Authority fixture uses real destination assertion at write time: a changed captured generation rejects selector-moving update. This checks CLI fence forwarding, not a real server transaction.

cases.title: lets a move onto a still-registered host through, carrying the incarnation it captured
cases.reason: Successful registered-generation move forwards independently expected target ID and generation in the actual update request.

cases.title: fences a create on an older host that only answers the legacy SSH listing
cases.reason: Unsupported modern SSH summary method falls back to the older listing while retaining the generation in the create request, preserving mixed-version use.

cases.title: omits the destination when the authority registers the target without a generation
cases.reason: Generation-less old host still receives the update with no invented destination. Mutation skipping the write fails the original assertion because toHaveProperty requires an actual object.

cases.title: sends a self destination for a local project
cases.reason: Local project create carries explicit self destination even with no SSH registrations.

cases.title: sends no destination when the edit names no project or workspace
cases.reason: Name-only update performs no repo resolution and omits destination. Mutation skipping the write fails original toHaveProperty; additional count assertion was unnecessary.
